description: This file defines a JavaScript module that exports a function to fetch session duration histogram data from a backend API. It includes helper functions for building query strings, and exposes a single main function 'getDurationHistogram' that constructs API requests, processes responses, and handles errors. It is part of the frontend code communicating with a backend for session analytics.
